items.text: NY Jets (Wed/Thu practice): DNP - WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/groin, likely out), DT Harrison Phillips (ankle). LIMITED - WR Isaiah Williams, G Dylan Parham, EDGE Joseph Ossai. DTs David Onyemata, T'Vondre Sweat designated to return from IR. Geno Smith starts.

Miami (Wed/Thu practice): DNP - CB JuJu Brents (shoulder/neck), P Bradley Pinion, WR Jared Wayne. LIMITED - RT Austin Jackson, LB Ronnie Harrison Jr., S Dante Trader Jr. IR - QB Malik Willis, RB De'Von Achane. Kyle McCord starts.
